hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- only the +0x258 instance was read in the aligned view; the other two were identified from the fndiff --ops cluster list and their operand identity has not been confirmed.
hypothesis.statement: The three lfs-vs-lwz swaps are ONE mechanism, not three: at each DmgFxCircleAdd/DmgFxConeAdd call the target evaluates the object-pointer argument LAST (`lwz r3,208(r27)` at +0x26c, after all three `lfs`) while ours evaluates it FIRST. Reordering the C argument expressions cannot change evaluation order by itself, but hoisting the pointer argument into a local read at the call -- or, conversely, spelling the float arguments as a preceding assignment -- should move it. Closing one instance should close all three, which would be worth far more than the two idiom rows this record parks.
